user.title: Adaptive Alarm — new configuration
user.description: Enter only the integration name. After setup, open Configure to select required contacts, alternative groups, optional sensors, vibrations and an inactive siren. No physical commands are sent.

abort.already_configured: Adaptive Alarm has already been configured.

init.title: Adaptive Alarm configuration

menu_options.group: Add or edit a required group (alternatives)

init.description: Choose a section. The siren stays disabled. Real deterrent lighting is possible only after explicitly enabling it in its own settings.

menu_option_descriptions.mandatory: Set required contacts and an optional lock.
menu_option_descriptions.group: EVERY group is required; one closed contact within each group is enough.
menu_option_descriptions.optional: Add contacts that do not block arming.
menu_option_descriptions.vibrations: Add, edit, or remove any number of sensors, each with its own physical contact.
menu_option_descriptions.siren: Optional siren selection, without any actuation.
menu_option_descriptions.timing: Set delays, debounce, required hit count and recovery behavior.
menu_option_descriptions.deterrent: OFF by default: physical lighting only after explicit opt-in.
menu_option_descriptions.notifications: Choose explicit HA notify targets. Telegram Bot uses notify entities.
menu_option_descriptions.notification_test: Only sends a message to configured targets, without triggering the alarm.

mandatory.title: Mandatory contacts and optional lock
mandatory.description: All mandatory contacts must be closed at the end of arming. A lock is optional and, if chosen, must be locked. The integration cannot arm without at least one mandatory contact or alternative group.

group.title: Add or edit a required group (alternatives)
group.description: This is a REQUIRED group. At least one of its contacts must be closed to arm. ALL groups must be satisfied together. Reuse the name to edit.

optional.title: Optional contacts
optional.description: Optional contacts do not prevent arming, but closed ones are frozen into the protected session.

data.optional: Other monitored contacts (not required to arm)

vibrations.title: Vibration sensors (any number)
vibrations.description: Link each vibration sensor to its actual mounted contact. Hits are counted per sensor; different windows cannot confirm one another.

siren.title: Optional siren (INERT / DISABLED)
siren.description: Save an optional siren or switch entity for future use. NO service calls will be made, even when simulated triggering occurs. Leave empty during testing.

timing.title: Timing, vibration threshold and recovery
timing.description: Vibrations are tracked per sensor. Choose 2 or 3 hits from the SAME sensor within the configured window. First valid hit creates a prealert. Debounce filters rapid repeats. Previous cross-sensor and storm-grace behaviors are no longer used.

data.vibration_threshold: Hits from same sensor to trigger (2 or 3)

vibration_add.title: Add vibration sensor
vibration_add.description: Choose the vibration sensor and its actual physical contact, which must already be monitored.

vibration_edit.title: Edit linked contact
vibration_edit.description: Choose a sensor to edit. To change the source, remove it and add it again.

vibration_edit_contact.title: Vibration physical contact
vibration_edit_contact.description: Select the new physical contact linked to this sensor.

vibration_remove.title: Remove vibration sensor
vibration_remove.description: Removes only this sensor association, without changing the monitored contacts.

deterrent.title: Deterrent lights on first hit (optional)
deterrent.description: If enabled, the first valid vibration requests light.turn_on only for lights initially OFF. Automatic turn-off is a SEPARATE opt-in, OFF by default: never turns off lights already ON or modified meanwhile, and never during simulated trigger. After restart lights stay ON for manual review. No siren actions.

data.deterrent_enabled: Enable actual light turn-on at prealert

notifications.title: Phone notifications (HA App, Telegram, others)
notifications.description: OFF by default. Select one or more notify.* entities (including modern Telegram Bot chat targets), or notify.mobile_app_* and other existing HA notify actions. Do not enter Telegram credentials here; configure the bot separately in Home Assistant. Test sends a real message. Accepted service request does not guarantee delivery to the phone.

error.invalid_rules: Duplicate sensors, invalid group or incompatible rule. Each contact may appear only once across mandatory/alternative/optional lists.
error.unpaired_vibration: Every vibration sensor must have a physical contact (and vice versa).
error.invalid_vibration_zone: Linked physical contact must be in monitored contacts.
error.deterrent_no_lights: Select at least one light before enabling deterrence.
error.notification_no_targets: Select at least one target to enable notifications.
error.notification_service_missing: The chosen notify service is not available.
error.invalid_notification_target: Invalid notification target: only notify services/entities are permitted.

abort.active_session: Disarm the alarm before changing protection rules or settings.
abort.unlink_vibration_first: Unlink the vibration sensor from that contact before removing it from the protection rules.
abort.notification_test_sent: Test notification request sent. Check the phone: action success does not guarantee delivery.
abort.notification_test_failed: At least one test destination is missing or returned an error. Check logs.
abort.notification_no_targets: Select at least one target to enable notifications.
abort.invalid_notification_target: Invalid notification target: only notify services/entities are permitted.
